title: 36 Hours in Palm Beach, Fla.
abstract: This tiny island, north of Fort Lauderdale, boasts dreamy estates and wide, uncrowded beaches.

title: 36 Hours in Goa, India
abstract: Though often synonymous with hippies, it’s the Portuguese’s lingering influence that makes India’s seaside destination such an alluring place.

title: 36 Hours in Phuket, Thailand
abstract: In recent years the island has firmly reasserted itself as a premier beach resort in southern Thailand.

title: 36 Hours in Naples, Fla.
abstract: This small Gulf-side city has a pleasingly anodyne quality that’s worlds away from the cosmopolitan bustle found in Miami.

title: 36 Hours in San Antonio
abstract: This old city offers excellent Chicano art, church music that goes way beyond hymns, and plenty of that famous Texas hospitality.
